mapper.select: SELECT t.tid, t.name, t.color, t.create_time FROM tags t LEFT JOIN article_tags at ON at.tag_id = t.tid LEFT JOIN articles a ON a.article_id = at.article_id AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' GROUP BY t.tid, t.name, t.color, t.create_time ORDER BY COUNT(a.article_id) DESC, t.tid ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT t.tid, t.name, t.color, t.create_time FROM tags t WHERE t.name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY t.name ASC LIMIT #{limit}
